gen-dafont-bloody-gf-mozilla-text: Mozilla Text is a sans-serif whose big lowercase bodies and outward-flaring terminals make it look bolder than it is. Mozilla Text can be sized down a notch, since that heavy-looking lowercase holds its own under Bloody.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-nokora: Nokora reads clean and friendly, with an s that never pinches shut. Its dark stripe of lowercase gives Bloody's big round bowls something solid to push against down the page.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans: Noto Sans reads contemporary and plain-spoken, its lowercase bodies filling most of the letter height. And the sharpest quality here is the swing in voice, Bloody commanding while Noto Sans just speaks plainly.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Noto Sans Adlam keeps its curve endings well apart, and its c, s and z come out full and generous. Noto Sans Adlam is best at quiet clarity, where Bloody is best at commanding attention.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-anatolian: Bloody's lowercase is built from huge round bowls that command the line. Then Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs steps in with outward-pointing terminals and lowercase rising close to cap height.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Bloody's lowercase is built from huge round bowls that make every word sound like an order. But Noto Sans Arabic does the quieter work, its wide openings and pronounced x-height keeping small letters clear.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-armenian: Noto Sans Armenian reads approachable and businesslike, with full-bodied c, s and z and wide, inviting openings on its round letters. Paragraphs of it stay unhurried and easygoing beneath Bloody.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Bloody's round, oversized bowls give every lowercase letter a commanding bark. Noto Sans Avestan is the quiet foil, its curve tips never touching, and that gap in temperament is the pair's best quality.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-balinese: Bloody's huge round bowls make its lowercase sound commanding at first glance. And Bloody earns its keep in big, short lines, while Noto Sans Balinese leaves breathing space inside every curve.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-bamum: Noto Sans Bamum reads modern and clean, its curved strokes stopping before they turn inward. Noto Sans Bamum stays out of Bloody's way, letting those huge round bowls do the commanding.
